notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
Experience smoother gameplay and improved performance in Sea of Dreams Survivors! This update brings major optimizations, bug fixes, and achievement improvements to make your journey even more enjoyable.

[h1]Performance & Technology[/h1]
[list]
[*] CPU Optimizations: Reduced processing load for smoother gameplay.
[*] Renderer Improvements: Optimized rendering pipeline for better frame rates.
[*] Engine Upgrade: Migrated from Monogame to KNI.
[*] Framework Update: Bumped to .NET 9 for improved stability and compatibility.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements & Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed "Why I doing this" achievement (too difficult).
[*] Fixed enemy kill achievements that were not triggering correctly.
[/list]

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Credits.
[*] Multiple behind-the-scenes improvements and bug fixes for enhanced stability.
[/list]

Enjoy a faster, smoother, and more polished Sea of Dreams Survivors!

notes.title: Dev Blog 3: The End Game Begins!
notes.notes:
First of all, a huge thank you to all of you! At the time of writing, [b]82 players[/b] have tried the Sea of Dreams Survivors demo, with over [b]400 games played[/b]—that means the world to us. Your support and feedback are incredibly valuable.

Today, let’s talk about what lies beyond the main campaign: the [b]End Game[/b].

[h1]Completing the Campaign[/h1]

The main campaign takes around 2 hours to complete on normal difficulty—a perfect entry point to learn the game and its mechanics. But don’t stop there!

If you’re feeling confident, try higher difficulties. Not only will the challenge increase, but you’ll also earn more XP, unlock new rewards, and gain additional Upgrade Points to power up your survivor.

[h1]🛠️ Custom Game Mode[/h1]

Once you complete the final level, you’ll unlock [b]Custom Game mode[/b].

[quote=The Game]"You've finished the game and unlocked Custom Game! You're now able to create your own settings and have fun for hundreds of hours."[/quote] 

In Custom Game, you can tailor the experience to your liking—whether you want an extreme challenge or something more experimental and fun. Here are the parameters you can tweak:

[list]
[*] Number of Weapons: Choose how many weapons your survivor can carry.
[*] Number of Perks: Control how many perks can be selected per run.
[*] Shield Capacity: Adjust your shield as a percentage of the default.
[*] Player Speed: Modify how fast your survivor moves.
[*] Auto-Select on Level Up: Toggle whether choices are made automatically when you level up.
[*] Endless Mode: Activate infinite waves for a true test of endurance.
[*] Endless Power Cycle: Set how your stats grow during each endless cycle.
[/list]

This mode is perfect for theory-crafting builds, stress-testing loadouts, or just diving into pure chaos.

[h1]🔁 Reset Upgrades Anytime[/h1]
Want to experiment with new builds? You can reset your upgrades at any time—even before finishing the campaign. But once you reach the End Game, this feature becomes even more valuable. Try bold combinations and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

[h1]🎖️ Ranks and Unlocks[/h1]

Finishing the campaign on normal difficulty is just the beginning. To unlock the most powerful weapons and earn more Upgrade Points, you may need to grind a bit—or take on tougher difficulties. Each run contributes to your Rank, which in turn opens up new possibilities for progression and power.


That’s all for now! We’re excited to see how you tackle the End Game. Share your builds, feedback, and chaos with us—we’re listening. And again, thank you for being part of the journey.

[i]Stay sharp, survivor. The Other World isn’t done with you yet.[/i]

notes.title: Dev Blog 2: Difficulties, Rogue-lite, Demo...
notes.notes:
[b]Hey again![/b]
Yep, I’m already back—it’s only been a few days since the last Dev Blog, but there’s a lot I want to share with you. So, let’s jump right in!

[h1]Difficulty System[/h1]
In Sea of Dreams Survivors, you have full control over how challenging you want the game to be. Choose between Easy, Normal, Heroic, and Legendary difficulties. Once you complete a level, an indicator shows which difficulty you’ve beaten it on—super helpful if you’re going for that sweet 100% completion!

Here’s what each difficulty brings to the table:

[list]
[*] Easy – Crush your enemies with minimal resistance.
[*] Normal – A balanced challenge with fair, intense battles.
[*] Heroic – A real test of skill—victory isn’t guaranteed!
[*] Legendary – Only the brave (or foolish) dare to try…
[/list]

Difficulty impacts things like enemy spawn rate, damage taken and dealt, knockback, and the number of enemies on screen.

[h1]Rogue-lite Mechanics[/h1]
Sea of Dreams Survivors isn’t just about moment-to-moment action—it’s got progression outside of the battlefield too.

Whether you win or lose a level, you’ll earn XP. Leveling up grants Upgrade Points, new weapons, and fresh perks. Sometimes, if you're stuck on a level, farming just a bit of XP can unlock the edge you need to push forward.

Upgrade Points can be spent in the Upgrade Menu, letting you unlock global perks across different tiers. These upgrades are permanent boosts that apply at the start of each game—things like more damage, extra health, or a stronger shield. No need to find them mid-run. Just equip and go!

[h1]Gameplay Tweaks & Visual Updates[/h1]
Since the initial reveal, Sea of Dreams Survivors has seen a lot of changes—and today, I’m excited to share a new gameplay screenshot highlighting some of them!

One of the most noticeable improvements is the slightly zoomed-out camera. This change boosts overall visibility, making it easier to spot incoming enemy waves and enjoy the action-packed chaos on screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/4ac98d9031ec73d0f307bf8ad64bd235350a2f05.png[/img]

To match this wider view, the game assets have been adjusted to a lower resolution. Since fine details aren’t as visible anymore, this shift adds a stylized, pixel-art flair that blends retro charm with a modern feel. It’s all about clarity, style, and creating a better gameplay experience!

[h1]Demo Incoming![/h1]
Big shoutout to Nosteru in the comments of the last Dev Blog for the idea—thanks again, and don’t be shy to leave your thoughts too!

I’m excited to officially announce that a free demo of Sea of Dreams Survivors is on the way, and it’s coming to Steam this April!

The demo will be a compact but feature-rich taste of the game, including:

[list]
[*] 2 playable levels
[*] 7 ranks
[*] 6 perks
[*] 13 unique weapons
[*] 2 characters
[*] 14 enemy types
[/list]

Can’t wait to hear what you all think. Stay tuned—it’s almost here!

notes.title: Dev Blog 1: Weapons
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the First Dev Blog![/h1]

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who supported me during the reveal! In today’s crowded world of game development, it’s not easy to carve out your own space. Even if the wishlist numbers might seem small compared to bigger studios, for me, as a solo indie dev, it’s a meaningful and encouraging step forward.

In this first dev blog, I’m diving into one of the core pillars of the game: the weapon system.

[h1]“I Need a Weapon,” You Say?[/h1]

In Sea of Dreams Survivors, combat isn’t like your typical survivor-style game. The focus is heavily on ranged attacks and projectiles. Melee weapons are rare, and when they do appear, they're usually designed to push enemies back or support your ranged playstyle.

As you play, you’ll unlock new weapons and shape your build by leveling up. Defeating enemies earns you Crystal XP, and with each level-up, you’ll face a strategic decision: unlock a new weapon, upgrade one you already have, or do the same with a perk. (Or if you’re feeling chaotic, skip the upgrade entirely and push forward as-is.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/49903bacc76bf224c828faa898a5381cb8bf2c03.jpg[/img]

Each weapon can be upgraded up to five times—improving efficiency, adding projectiles, or even altering gameplay mechanics. The idea is to find your playstyle and build wild synergies to help you survive the relentless horrors of The Other World.

[h2]Arsenal Overview[/h2]
At launch, you’ll have access to over 21 unique weapons with a total of 105 upgrades. Here's a sneak peek at a few of them:

[b]🧤 The Repulsor[/b]
A high-tech lifesaver in The Other World. Use it to knock back enemies, maintain your distance, and strike precisely. It’s a must-have when things get overwhelming.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/b2fa5d6be1e9e2a5c1bfb9f9839a7d84deb3c11e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/3dac1f4610d1409015adee34bb70c016cdfc39bf.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]🔥 Shotgun[/b]
One shot is all it takes to turn enemies into a shower of blood and gore. When the horde closes in, this brutal weapon tears through crowds like a hot knife through... well, monsters. 💀💥

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/acec147e04b115acb0bd880cca522d0734a3feb0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/db4a9c1367b4813cb2a293f4706eb7a10933aa70.png[/img][/url]

[b]🔥 The Flamethrower[/b]
Engulf your enemies in flames and leave a trail of ashes behind. This weapon excels at clearing swarms and lighting up the darkness with fiery destruction.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/20f38e27229330fed1066c5ee3f8c714dd8060b6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527032/c576af97179288404615460211cfddba395b2842.png[/img][/url]

That’s all for now! Thanks for reading, and if you haven’t already, check out Sea of Dreams Survivors on Steam and add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484590/Sea_of_Dreams_Survivors/
